quests.title: Hyakunin Ikki: The Greatest Battle

dialogue.t: Why hello there, outlander! Do you have any interest in a little scrap, by any chance?

dialogue.sit: I've been in thousands of those.
Do you have a commission for me?

dialogue.t: Ah, wonderful! Glad I had my eye on the right person.
It's like this: recently, some people have organized a Hyakunin Ikki in secret again.

dialogue.sit: Don't you mean the Hyakunin Isshu?

dialogue.t: No, no, I said "Hyakunin Ikki." What on earth's the "Hyakunin Isshu," anyway...
This practice used to circulate amongst the Tengu-Kin, who imitated the tengu. Basically, they would do this—
When the situation went ill, when they felt down, when something worth celebrating occurred, or if they were simply bored...
They would engage in a hearty fight to celebrate, or simply to eliminate bad luck.

dialogue.sit: Sounds like you could just hold it at any time...

dialogue.t: ...Now that you mention it, that is true, yes.
Whatever the case, let's find another place to discuss this matter. There are too many people in the city for such talk...
Here we are.
You can enter the Hyakunin Ikki Dojo by stepping through this... rather suspicious door.
Though the Tengu-Kin have long been banned for flouting public order and morals, some still hold the Hyakunin Ikki free-for-all tournament from time to time.
Monsters, adventurers, and warriors who long for battle will be attracted here to engage in passionate battle on this stage.
Feel free to bring your friends and companions! After all, the "Hyakunin" in "Hyakunin Ikki" means the more, the merrier!
You seem like a well-traveled adventurer. You shouldn't lack for any companions to take part together with you.
Oh, of course I will — as a spectator, cheering you on!
In truth, my goal here is to write the most epic fighting novel ever and use it to take first prize in Yae Publishing House's "This Novel Is Amazing!" contest...
...And my gut tells me that your star will shine brightest in this arena.

Great! In fact, I already have a name for my novel. I'm calling it "Hyakunin Ikki: Greatest Battle Chapter." If you should see it in Yae Publishing House's store one day, look out for the bit where the blond-haired outlander makes their debut!
I'm looking forward to your performance.

quests.description: It seems that someone in Inazuma City is looking for an exceptional fighter…
